acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Slimes family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Ooze Knight, T3, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Crust-Stance Specialist (Specialist) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two wind construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: First roughly humanoid jelly outline, glowing crystalline chest core, and hardened shoulder crust arranged like armor.
Signature mechanic: Crust Stance: shoulder crust flows into one arm-like brace, guarding a lane while leaving the opposite core edge clear.
battlefieldDuty: Qualitatively pivot into a stance controller that moves its first humanoid crust between guard and thrust shapes.
constructionDimensions: Tier-safe anatomy: T1–T2 have no humanoid structure and streamline around the existing core; T3–T4 preserve their source-supported humanoid crust frame; T5 alone retains its dozen cores in separated pressure lobes.
Directional membrane ridges, debris streamers, vapor channels, flattened leading edges, and a still pocket behind the core show coherent pressure flow.
counterplay: Circle to the unarmored side and strike the exposed core edge before the brace liquefies and transfers. Affinity signal: Tier-safe anchors: T1–T2 have no humanoid structure and reveal one still core; T3–T4 expose a humanoid crust joint when flow reverses; T5 exposes one of its dozen cores when a pressure lobe collapses.
identityInvariants: Rounded, drooping, gravity-obeying jelly with surface-tension edges and a readable internal core remains the family silhouette.
Translucent blue, acid green, amber, or violet is chosen per individual, with suspended debris and a brighter but bounded core.
Viscous flow, drip trails, swallowed objects, crystalline cores, and later crust plates remain spatially coherent.
Internal structure emerges by tier: pseudopod, debris-bearing blob, humanoid crust frame, suspended skeleton, then a multicore tide.
telegraph: The glowing chest core slides under one shoulder and the crust audibly crystallizes there.
